page.overview:
What is Prime Reality?

The Prime Reality (a.k.a. Earth-616) is a fictional universe created by Marvel Comics which is inhabited by the Many-Angled Ones and Lovecraftian Elder Gods. It is the setting for most of the comic series published by Marvel Comics, with a few comic series focused on the universe itself (the cosmic character or team series). It has also been the stage of two cosmic horror stories, the Infinity Gauntlet event in 1991 and the Chaos War event in 2010. There were also several other universal level events, such as the Infinity War and the Infinity Crusade.

Within "known space" (the local group of galaxies) there have been various events and crossovers, ranging from those focused on a particular character or team (e.g., the Dark Phoenix Saga, the Brood Saga, the Thanos War, and Emperor Vulcan: The Rise and Fall of the Shi'ar Empire) to the intergalactic wars that altered the region's geopolitics (the Kree-Skrull War, Operation Galactic Storm, the Second Kree-Skrull War, Annihilation, Annihilation: Conquest, War of Kings, The Thanos Imperative, and Infinity).

The Prime Reality (Earth-616) is the mainstream reality of the Marvel Multiverse that is still expanding and currently contains billions of galaxies. Its existence is occasionally threatened by the super-genius and super-powered Thanos the Mad Titan and sometimes by someone else (e.g., the Lovecraftian entity Dormammu) and on occasion its existence is threatened by an entity or faction from another reality. In this reality, during the late 20th century and so far in the early part of the 21st century, it is usually someone from Earth or an alien who favors Earth, who saves the universe or "known space". Most of the time it is either the Silver Surfer, the Fantastic Four, the Avengers, or the X-Men (the latter three being from Earth).

The Old Ones have representation within the Prime Reality, either themselves or their minions. On occasion, those existing outside of the various universes (e.g., Shuma-Gorath and Slorioth) will manifest in the Prime Reality, though because of how incomprehensibly vast is their power, it is usually only the tiniest infinitesimal fragment of their being.
